entries.question: What is my deductible?
entries.answer: Your annual deductible is the amount you pay before your insurance kicks in. Refer to your policy document Section 3 for your specific amount.

entries.question: How do I file a claim?
entries.answer: Log into the member portal, go to Claims > Submit New Claim, and upload your hospital bill and discharge summary.

entries.question: Is physiotherapy covered?
entries.answer: Physiotherapy is covered up to 20 sessions per year under the Wellness add-on plan. Check if your plan includes this add-on.

entries.question: What is the cashless hospitalisation process?
entries.answer: Present your insurance card at any network hospital. The hospital will coordinate directly with us for pre-authorisation.

entries.question: What is covered under my plan?
entries.answer: Your plan covers inpatient hospitalisation, day care procedures, pre and post hospitalisation expenses, and ambulance charges. Add-on covers may include maternity, wellness, and dental.

entries.question: How do I add a family member to my policy?
entries.answer: Log into the member portal and go to Policy > Add Dependents. You can add spouse, children, and parents. Changes take effect from the next renewal date.

entries.question: What is the waiting period for pre-existing conditions?
entries.answer: Pre-existing conditions have a standard waiting period of 36 months from policy inception. Critical illness riders may have different waiting periods.

entries.question: How do I find a network hospital?
entries.answer: Visit our website and use the Hospital Locator tool under the Members section. You can search by city, pincode, or hospital name.

entries.question: What happens if I get hospitalized abroad?
entries.answer: Your annual deductible is the amount you pay before your insurance kicks in. Refer to your policy document Section 3 for your specific amount.
